policy: Only additive, backward-compatible database migrations may be marked safe, with one exception: a migration may drop the tables of modules this release removes, if an app rollback to the previous release has been tested against it (the old release must still start). Their data then lives only in the updater's pre-update dump. Review this for every release. App rollback never restores the database automatically.
v1.0.0: familyhub/0009 drops recipes, meal_plans, family_posts and family_post_seen (removed modules). Rollback to v0.3.7 tested on November 4, 2026: it starts and recreates those tables empty.
v1.1.0: familyhub/0011 adds a nullable push_subscriptions.account_id and an index (additive). App rollback to v1.0.0 tested on November 5, 2026: it starts and ignores the column.
v1.2.0: familyhub/0012 creates familyhub_dashboard_extras and familyhub_photos (new tables only). App rollback to v1.0.0 tested on November 5, 2026: it starts and ignores them. Uploaded photos live in the uploads volume under familyhub-photos/.
v1.3.0: No migration. News feeds are a new key in the existing familyhub_dashboard_extras settings document; v1.2.0 ignores it and shows the BBC defaults after a rollback.
v1.4.2: familyhub/0013 deletes the rows of user_identities and oidc_flows (single sign-on removed); the tables stay. App rollback to v1.4.0 tested: it starts, and accounts are simply unlinked from Google sign-in.
v1.4.1: Same code as v1.4.0 (released before the fix reached familyhub/prototype).
v1.5.0: familyhub/0014 adds budget_groups, budget_settlements and budget_sharing_settings and nullable/defaulted paid_by, split_with and group_id columns (additive); it also renames legacy French budget categories to the new fixed keys and removes the budget list from users.custom_categories. familyhub/0015 deletes a legacy limit only where the new key already has a limit for the same month. App rollback to v1.4.2 tested on November 6, 2026 against a fictional upgraded database: it starts, lists entries (new keys show as plain category names), adds entries and reads limits.
v1.5.2: familyhub/0016 adds a nullable familyhub_ambient_settings.layout and familyhub/0017 a nullable users.familyhub_nav_order (both additive). App rollback to v1.5.1 tested on November 6, 2026 against a fictional upgraded database: it starts, serves the display settings and snapshot with the extra column ignored (widgets kept in step), and /api/familyhub/nav is simply absent.
v1.5.3: No migration (restart from Settings, Settings layout, F1 schedule fallback).
v1.5.4: Same code as v1.5.3 (released before the screensaver reached familyhub/prototype).
v1.5.5: familyhub/0018 adds night_mode, screensaver_enabled and screensaver_minutes to familyhub_ambient_settings, all NOT NULL with defaults (additive); an older server ignores them.
